objective.text: The objective of this investigation is to better understand the relationship between electric field voltage and chemi-ion current, analyze the dynamic response of flames to electric field changes, evaluate soot formation, and characterize stabilized near-limit lifted flames.
objective.quote: The objective of this investigation is to better understand the relationship between electric field voltage and chemi-ion current, analyze the dynamic response of flames to electric field changes, evaluate soot formation, and characterize stabilized near-limit lifted flames.

fuel.text: Methane and ethylene were used as fuels.
fuel.quote: Methane and ethylene were used as fuels and diluted with nitrogen to control flame strength.

sample_geometry.text: The gas-jet burner is used to create a small, focused flame for detailed ion-driven convection studies while the coflow burner surrounds the fuel jet with a weak synthetic air flow.
sample_geometry.quote: The gas-jet burner is used to create a small, focused flame for detailed ion-driven convection studies while the coflow burner surrounds the fuel jet with a weak synthetic air flow to enable flame stability and soot behavior analysis.

source.ref: Objectives, Approach, Hypothesis, Research Impacts/Earth Benefits

flow.text: The coflow burner surrounds the fuel jet with a weak synthetic air flow.
flow.quote: the coflow burner surrounds the fuel jet with a weak synthetic air flow to enable flame stability and soot behavior analysis.

variables.text: Parameters such as fuel flow rate, coflow velocity, and field polarity are were varied to isolate specific effects on ion production, flame stability, and soot behavior.
variables.quote: Parameters such as fuel flow rate, coflow velocity, and field polarity are were varied to isolate specific effects on ion production, flame stability, and soot behavior.

measurements.text: High-resolution cameras captured flame shape, luminosity, and soot distribution.
measurements.quote: High-resolution cameras captured flame shape, luminosity, and soot distribution.

safety_finding.text: The application of electric fields in microgravity environments will significantly influence laminar diffusion flames by enabling precise manipulation of flame stability, soot behavior, and combustion dynamics through ion-driven convection and chemi-ionization processes.
safety_finding.quote: The application of electric fields in microgravity environments will significantly influence laminar diffusion flames by enabling precise manipulation of flame stability, soot behavior, and combustion dynamics through ion-driven convection and chemi-ionization processes.

earth_benefits.text: The use of electric fields to control flames can reduce the production of harmful pollutants in practical terrestrial combustion.
